list_child.name: listLeaseRegister
list_child.desc: Retrieves every lease agreement in the company's lease register. Use it when you need to review the whole portfolio of agreements at once.

decoys.name: listLeaseLedger
decoys.desc: Retrieves every lease agreement in the company's rent ledger. Use it when you need to review the whole set of rent schedules at once.

decoys.name: listLeaseVault
decoys.desc: Retrieves every lease agreement in the company's scanned document vault. Use it when you need to review the whole archive of signed paper originals at once.

decoys.name: listLeaseBinder
decoys.desc: Retrieves every lease agreement in the company's compliance binder. Use it when you need to review the whole set of filings kept for the housing authority at once.

get_child.name: getLeaseAgreement
get_child.desc: Retrieves the agreement file for a single lease using its unique identifier. This is the appropriate call when you already know which lease you want and need its current details.

decoys.name: getLeaseLedger
decoys.desc: Retrieves the rent ledger for a single lease using its unique identifier. This is the appropriate call when you already know which lease you want and need its payment history.

decoys.name: getLeaseInspection
decoys.desc: Retrieves the move-in inspection report for a single lease using its unique identifier. This is the appropriate call when you already know which lease you want and need its recorded unit condition.

decoys.name: getLeaseDeposit
decoys.desc: Retrieves the security deposit account for a single lease using its unique identifier. This is the appropriate call when you already know which lease you want and need its held balance.

list_parent.name: listLandlordAccounts
list_parent.desc: Retrieves every landlord in the company's owner accounts roster. Useful for browsing ownership records before drilling into a specific landlord's leases.

decoys.name: listLandlordProspects
decoys.desc: Retrieves every landlord in the company's owner prospects pipeline. Useful for browsing management pitches before following up with a specific landlord.

decoys.name: listLandlordPayees
decoys.desc: Retrieves every landlord in the company's disbursement payee list. Useful for browsing payout setups before sending a specific landlord's monthly distribution.

decoys.name: listLandlordFilers
decoys.desc: Retrieves every landlord in the company's year-end tax reporting list. Useful for browsing 1099 details before filing a specific landlord's annual forms.

get_parent.name: getLandlordAccount
get_parent.desc: Retrieves the account file for a single landlord by its identifier. Use this to pull up ownership and contact details for one landlord specifically.

decoys.name: getLandlordStatement
decoys.desc: Retrieves the owner statement for a single landlord by its identifier. Use this to pull up income and expense totals for one landlord specifically.

decoys.name: getLandlordContract
decoys.desc: Retrieves the management agreement for a single landlord by its identifier. Use this to pull up fee terms and service scope for one landlord specifically.

decoys.name: getLandlordTax
decoys.desc: Retrieves the tax profile for a single landlord by its identifier. Use this to pull up the tax ID and payee details for one landlord specifically.

delete_child.name: deleteLeaseRecord
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a lease agreement's record from the system, and the deletion is final once submitted. Use this for records that should disappear from every report and filing.

decoys.name: deleteLeaseLedger
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes a lease agreement's rent ledger from the system, and the deletion is final once submitted. Use this for ledgers that were imported with the wrong charges or tenants.

decoys.name: deleteLeaseScans
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes a lease agreement's scanned documents from the system, and the deletion is final once submitted. Use this for scans that were uploaded against the wrong unit or tenant.

decoys.name: deleteLeaseInspection
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes a lease agreement's move-in inspection from the system, and the deletion is final once submitted. Use this for inspections that were filed against the wrong unit or date.

set_enum.name: setRegisterStage
set_enum.desc: Updates a lease agreement's stage in the lease register to draft, active, or terminated. This should be called any time the lease's standing changes so the register and its reports stay accurate.

decoys.name: setPortalStage
decoys.desc: Updates a lease agreement's stage in the tenant portal to draft, active, or terminated. This should be called any time the tenant needs to see a different standing when they log in.

decoys.name: setLedgerStage
decoys.desc: Updates a lease agreement's stage in the accounting ledger to draft, active, or terminated. This should be called any time rent charges need to start or stop posting against the agreement.

decoys.name: setListingStage
decoys.desc: Updates a lease agreement's stage on the rental listing feed to draft, active, or terminated. This should be called any time the unit's public listing needs to go up or come down.

set_bool.name: flagRenewalPending
set_bool.desc: Marks a lease agreement as being up for renewal in the near future. This helps the renewals team prioritize which agreements need outreach first.

decoys.name: flagCoSigned
decoys.desc: Marks a lease agreement as being co-signed by a guarantor. This helps the leasing team track which agreements carry a second party on the hook.

decoys.name: flagRentControlled
decoys.desc: Marks a lease agreement as being subject to local rent control rules. This helps the accounting team cap which agreements can take an increase.

decoys.name: flagLegalHold
decoys.desc: Marks a lease agreement as being under legal hold for a dispute. This helps the legal team track which agreements must stay frozen for now.

set_ref.name: transferLease
set_ref.desc: Transfers a lease agreement to a different landlord's portfolio within the system. Use this when ownership of the underlying property changes hands.

decoys.name: chargeLease
decoys.desc: Bills a lease agreement's repair costs to a different landlord's account within the system. Use this when another owner is responsible for a shared building expense.

decoys.name: payoutLease
decoys.desc: Routes a lease agreement's rent payouts to a different landlord's bank account within the system. Use this when co-owners split the income from a property.

decoys.name: discloseLease
decoys.desc: Discloses a lease agreement's file to a different landlord's portal within the system. Use this when a co-owner needs to review the agreement's terms.

send.name: emailLandlord
send.desc: Sends an email notification to a landlord regarding one of their properties. This is the standard channel for routine written updates about a unit.

decoys.name: callLandlord
decoys.desc: Places a phone call to a landlord regarding one of their properties. This is the standard channel for urgent spoken updates about a unit.

decoys.name: invoiceLandlord
decoys.desc: Sends a maintenance invoice to a landlord regarding one of their properties. This is the standard channel for billing repair work done on a unit.

decoys.name: mailLandlord
decoys.desc: Sends a certified letter to a landlord regarding one of their properties. This is the standard channel for formal notices that need proof of delivery.
child_verbs: send a certified letter to the landlord behind {obj}
mail the landlord tied to {obj} a certified letter

create.name: createLease
create.desc: Creates a new lease agreement for a landlord, with an optional property and starting stage. It is used when a unit is being set up for a new tenancy.

decoys.name: createListing
decoys.desc: Creates a new rental listing for a landlord, with an optional property and starting stage. It is used when a vacant unit is being advertised to prospects.

decoys.name: createApplication
decoys.desc: Creates a new rental application for a landlord, with an optional property and starting stage. It is used when a prospect applies to rent one of the units.

decoys.name: createInspection
decoys.desc: Creates a new unit inspection for a landlord, with an optional property and starting stage. It is used when a walkthrough of a unit is being scheduled.

list_notes.name: listLeaseMemos
list_notes.desc: Retrieves the memos attached to a single lease agreement. It includes every observation staff have logged about that agreement.

decoys.name: listLeaseCharges
decoys.desc: Retrieves the rent charges attached to a single lease agreement. It includes every fee the accounting team has posted against that agreement.

decoys.name: listLeaseRequests
decoys.desc: Retrieves the maintenance requests attached to a single lease agreement. It includes every repair the tenant has reported under that agreement.

decoys.name: listLeaseViolations
decoys.desc: Retrieves the violation notices attached to a single lease agreement. It includes every breach staff have documented under that agreement.

add_note.name: addLeaseMemo
add_note.desc: Attaches a new memo to a lease agreement, with an optional title. It is used to record observations from staff about the agreement.

decoys.name: addLeaseCharge
decoys.desc: Posts a new rent charge to a lease agreement, with an optional title. It is used to record a fee owed by the tenant on the agreement.

decoys.name: addLeaseRequest
decoys.desc: Logs a new maintenance request on a lease agreement, with an optional title. It is used to record a repair the tenant reported on the unit.

decoys.name: addLeaseViolation
decoys.desc: Files a new violation notice on a lease agreement, with an optional title. It is used to record a breach of the agreement's terms.

update_note.name: editLeaseMemo
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing memo on a lease agreement. It is used to correct or expand a memo after it has been logged.

decoys.name: editLeaseCharge
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing rent charge on a lease agreement. It is used to correct a fee description after it has been posted.

decoys.name: editLeaseRequest
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing maintenance request on a lease agreement. It is used to update a repair's details after the tenant reports it.

decoys.name: editLeaseViolation
decoys.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing violation notice on a lease agreement. It is used to revise a documented breach before it is served.

delete_note.name: deleteLeaseMemo
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a memo from a lease agreement. The memo is erased from the lease file for good.

decoys.name: deleteLeaseCharge
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a rent charge from a lease agreement. The fee is erased from the tenant ledger for good.

decoys.name: deleteLeaseRequest
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a maintenance request from a lease agreement. The repair ticket is erased from the work queue for good.

decoys.name: deleteLeaseViolation
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a violation notice from a lease agreement. The breach is erased from the tenant history for good.

set_image.name: setLeasePhoto
set_image.desc: Sets the photo shown on a lease agreement record. It is typically an exterior shot of the rental property.

decoys.name: setLeaseFloorplan
decoys.desc: Sets the floor plan on a lease agreement record. It is typically the unit layout drawing supplied by the landlord.

decoys.name: setLeaseCondition
decoys.desc: Sets the condition photo on a lease agreement record. It is typically a picture of the unit taken at the move-in walkthrough.

decoys.name: setLeaseSignature
decoys.desc: Sets the signature image on a lease agreement record. It is typically the tenant's scanned signature from the signing page.

writer.name: writeUpdate
writer.desc: Writes a short update from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the leases it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeNotice
decoys.desc: Writes a short tenant notice from a brief, which states what to announce in the requester's own words, and the leases it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeListing
decoys.desc: Writes a short rental listing from a brief, which states what to highlight in the requester's own words, and the leases it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: writeReport
decoys.desc: Writes a short owner report from a brief, which states what to cover in the requester's own words, and the leases it should mention. It returns the finished text.

image.name: generatePicture
image.desc: Generates a picture from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: generateFloorplan
decoys.desc: Generates a floor plan drawing from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the drawing.

decoys.name: generateStaging
decoys.desc: Generates a virtual staging render from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the render.

decoys.name: generateFlyer
decoys.desc: Generates a vacancy flyer from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the flyer.

search.name: searchHelp
search.desc: Searches the help center and user guides with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the management system works.

decoys.name: searchStatutes
decoys.desc: Searches the landlord-tenant statutes and local ordinances with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a legal notice period.

decoys.name: searchClauses
decoys.desc: Searches the lease clause library and standard addenda with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up wording for an agreement.

decoys.name: searchBylaws
decoys.desc: Searches the HOA docs and building rules with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up what a community allows.
